findings.text: Requirement 4 ("If the page can fail silently, make it show an error instead of Loading forever") is not in the diff. The change edits the test, the readme and one page.jsonl line. TasksPage.js and the Task.js replay path are untouched, so a throw in replay can still leave a page at "Loading" (diff.patch, whole).

The test was rewritten to match the new behaviour rather than the page being repaired. It now asserts that /tasks/ forwards away from TasksPage. If the cause was a duplicate page.jsonl declaration (the old TasksPage line sat after the SavedFilter line), that is a fair fix. The diff does not record that cause, and requirement 1 asks for it to be recorded (diff.patch, public/tasks/page.jsonl).

The /tasks/ shot shows the AI Inbox titled "AI". It lists sessions (chips All, Voice, Servex, Scheduled, Live) and a "Today" date rail. The page.jsonl description says the Inbox opens with the "Tasks and Home chips on" (preset all-tasks). Neither chip is visible, and no task rows are shown (shots/monorepo-localhost-tasks/1920.png, main band). The forward lands on the right module, but the saved filter does not appear applied. Either the preset is not honoured or the shot caught it before it applied.

The readme edit repeats itself: "(…the /live/ Tasks card counts from it):  `public/tasks/task.jsonl` holds one reference per home…" restates the index sentence, and there is a double space after the colon (Task/readme.md, TasksPage paragraph). Law 1 and law 2 prefer one clear sentence.

The 400 shot shows "✦AI" and "☰Menu" rail buttons reported as wrapping at 3.2 lines (layout.json 400 wraps). The icon sits above the label, so this is probably a stacked layout and not a real wrap. It is not part of this diff.
Requirement 6 (answer every review finding in the task log, `--status` passes) cannot be checked from the diff. The report covers shots and the patch only.

The shot of /tasks/ shows the "AI" sessions inbox (sessions, Voice/Servex groups, $ costs), not tasks. The saved filter says `preset: all-tasks` with "Tasks and Home chips on", yet no task rows and no Tasks/Home chips are visible (shots/monorepo-localhost-tasks/1920.png, main column). Either the shot hit the main checkout rather than the worktree, or the forward lands on a page that does not show tasks. Confirm in the worktree that /tasks/ really lists tasks.

The cause is not recorded in the diff (requirements step "record what the cause was"). The diff only updates the test's expectations and the readme to say /tasks/ forwards to the Inbox. The readme says it forwards, but it never says that the old "Loading" hang was a stale test or a stale `page.jsonl` class line, and the commit message was not provided. State the cause in the task log or the readme.
`TasksPage.into` starts a 30 s `setTimeout` that is never cleared. It is harmless, but the timer keeps running after a fast load and rejects a settled race. Add a `clearTimeout` in `finally`.
The 30 s `LOAD_MS` is longer than the test's own 20 s wait. A hang therefore still fails the test before the error text shows. This is fine for users but the test cannot exercise the new error path.
Widths given: 400 and 1920. At 400 the `.drawer-rail-ai` and `.drawer-rail-menu` buttons wrap to 3.2 lines (layout.json wraps). These are existing chrome, not part of this diff.

answer.reply: noted: confirmed, and worse than a stale shot. /tasks/ forwards to /framework/ai/?kind=task&home, but /framework/ai/ is now the AIDashboard (sessions by origin, 10-19 merge 6feb47b6f) and it does not read the kind/home chips: no Tasks or Home chip, no task rows (checked in a browser on the main site). SavedFilter is right as the 10-19 decision, but its target stopped honouring the preset. Fixing it means teaching AIDashboard a tasks filter or pointing /tasks/ at a task list: the architect's call, out of this task's fence. Until then TasksPage (module tasks/ paths, Doc Tasks tabs) is the only task list.
